# Ion Mikel Liberal



I am a PhD student in IIIA-CSIC and I am studying MaxSAT both from a practical and theoretical point of view. On the one side, my work focuses on the design of new algorithms inside the SAT-based paradigm. On the other side, I studied the strengths and limitations of these algorithms through the proof complexity of the induced proof systems. 
:::

:::
